# Gladly: AI Shopping Assistant

Pricing

Developer [ Gladly Inc ](https://apps.shopify.com/partners/gladly10)

## Help shoppers find and buy the right product in chat, with AI that remembers them after the sale.

- Product discovery: Recommends the right products from your catalog in chat
- Compare options: Answers product questions, compares items, synthesizes reviews
- Buy in chat: Shoppers add to cart and check out without leaving the conversation
- Remembers every shopper: Past purchases and preferences carry into every chat
- After the sale: Handles orders and returns, then hands off with full context

Languages

English

 Works with

- [Checkout](https://apps.shopify.com/extensions/checkout?surface_detail=gladly&surface_type=app_details)
- 50+ Integrations
- Attentive
- Klaviyo
- Postscript
- Stella Connect
- Yotpo

## Pricing

 Choose the plan that best fits your business.

 External charges may be billed by Gladly Inc separately from your Shopify invoice. [ Learn more ](https://www.gladly.ai/get-started/?utm_source=sh0pify&utm_medium=referral&utm_term=learn+more)

 Free plan

### Free

 Features

- 100 AI interactions to test out
- AI agent for chat & email
- Shopify product recommendations
- Integrates with Shopify, Klaviyo & more
- 1 team member seat

 Starter cap

### $250 / month

 Set your monthly limit and pay as you go. Everything in the free trial + unlimited interactions up to your spending cap.

 Features

- $1.50 per AI Resolution
- $0.25 per AI Assist
- $120/mo per team member

 All charges are billed in USD. Recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days.
